facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: She heard a sound. It was a frog. The frog could talk. A frog came up.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: While the princess was crying, she heard a splash. A small green frog climbed up from inside the well. A frog came up and asked why she was so sad. The princess was surprised that a frog could talk. The frog offered to help her get the golden ball back. The princess felt a tiny spark of hope in her heart.
facts.Word cards: princess = 공주 / ball = 공 / golden = 황금색의 / well = 우물
